population_dynamics.title: Conditional flow matching in acute human wounds: a three-donor audit of population reconstruction

claims.value: GSE241132: 3 healthy donors; Skin/Wound1/Wound7/Wound30
claims.scope: acute human wound method test
claims.allowed_wording: The human experiment used three healthy donors with four acute-wound time points.

claims.value: held-out Wound7 +49.9%; leave-one-donor 3/3
claims.scope: held-out timepoint
claims.allowed_wording: Global Wound7 prediction improved by 49.9%; all three drop-one-donor runs improved for the retained donors, not for the omitted donor.

claims.value: donor transfer 3/3; mean improvement +75.9%; cosine mean +0.948
claims.scope: held-out donor acute human cohort
claims.allowed_wording: A shared field transferred across the three acute-wound donors under the specified protocol, but this does not establish DFU prediction.

claims.value: historical single-seed nearest-grid linear-days improvement -18.2%; retained only in tab:p2axes; current Figure 4 uses P2-PAIRED-CLOCK
claims.scope: time-axis ablation
claims.allowed_wording: Retained for historical comparison only, not the current Figure 4 and not paired with the revised exact-time fits.

claims.value: historical shared CFM mean ED 0.3947; target-marginal matched mean ED 0.1818; target-marginal lower for PWH26/PWH27 but not PWH28
claims.scope: historical shared-field benchmark with added matched target-marginal evaluation; not a new fit
claims.allowed_wording: The historical shared field and added target-marginal baseline have different donor-specific errors; the marginal baseline is lower on average but not universally.

claims.value: historical conditioned in-sample gains 6/6; held-out mean ED conditioned 0.6176 versus shared 0.3947
claims.scope: unchanged historical conditioning comparison split from P2-C05; not a revised fit or independent replication
claims.allowed_wording: Conditioned CFM shows 6/6 sample-in gains without a held-out mean advantage over shared CFM in the historical comparison; this does not identify the correct model class.

claims.value: common-reference 27-fit shared CFM k=1 mean ED 0.5466; k=2 mean ED 0.3983; mean reduction 0.1483
claims.scope: two-point donor learning curve
claims.allowed_wording: Adding a second training donor reduced shared-field mean held-out error under a common scoring reference; simple controls also improved.

claims.value: common-reference seed reductions 0.1430-0.1558; max configuration seed range 0.3377; mean within-configuration SD 0.0701
claims.scope: three training seeds
claims.allowed_wording: The aggregate common-reference reduction was positive for all three seeds, while individual configurations showed larger run-to-run variation.

claims.value: mouse NDB POD7 improvement -1.5%; one animal per time point; panel coverage 59.7%
claims.scope: computational mouse audit
claims.allowed_wording: The repaired mouse POD7 audit did not beat stay-still by the reported -1.5% margin and is not a species or DFU validation.

claims.value: Three mouse arms: NDB -1.5%, PDB +32.1% with failed endpoint-distance ordering, GDB +50.6%; 2/3 beat baseline and split-half criterion; 2/3 meet ordering screen
claims.scope: one-animal-per-timepoint computational arm audit; not statistical inference or DFU validation
claims.allowed_wording: The three-arm audit shows model-arm heterogeneity under a common protocol and cannot establish a biological or clinical trajectory.

claims.value: common-reference donor-block reduction 0.1483; descriptive range [0.0732,0.2727]; plateau unsupported
claims.scope: three held-out donor blocks; two-point curve uncertainty audit
claims.allowed_wording: Adding a second donor improved the aggregate common-reference two-point pilot, but the block range and two-point design cannot identify a plateau or required cohort size.

claims.value: same-donor temporal versus same-time donor median ratio 8.46; bootstrap 95% interval 6.02–13.11; mean displacement cosine 0.948 with descriptive interval 0.943–0.954
claims.scope: three healthy acute-wound donors; geometry uncertainty audit
claims.allowed_wording: Within this three-donor acute-wound cohort, temporal separation is larger than same-time donor separation and displacement directions are aligned; the interval is descriptive and not a universal donor/time claim.

claims.value: common-reference mean-displacement k=1 ED 0.5095, k=2 ED 0.4186; reduction 0.0909
claims.scope: Deterministic non-neural control scored in the same common reference across the three-seed, two-point donor-count design; repeated evaluations are not new donors
claims.allowed_wording: Adding a second donor also improves mean-displacement prediction, so the observed count benefit is not unique to the neural field.

claims.claim: Fixed-field prediction is stable to the tested integration resolutions and evaluation subsamples; no extra independent donors.

claims.value: Cell-pooled improvement 49.4000%; equal-donor-mass 49.6939%; donor-specific range 40.0654% to 47.1515%
claims.scope: Same saved pooled time-holdout field and scaler, all source and target cells
claims.allowed_wording: Fixed-field improvement persists under equal donor mass; these are not new donor-transfer folds.

claims.value: Global day-7 mean donor ED: centroid 0.6674, field 0.8110; day-1 centroid 0.9293, field 1.0571
claims.scope: Retrospective global missing-time reconstruction; same-donor future anchor is permitted; three seeds are not donors
claims.allowed_wording: Centroid translation has lower mean error than shared flow in both globally missing-time tasks. The separate held-donor ranking does not establish general neural superiority.

claims.value: Location-scale ED 0.6982 at day 7 and 0.9034 at day 1; both deterministic endpoint controls beat flow in all 50 matched cell draws per held time
claims.scope: Same three donors and six saved field fits; retrospective endpoint-informed reconstruction
claims.allowed_wording: Simple endpoint controls remain competitive under matched evaluation. Centered energy distance shows task-dependent shape errors and is not an additive or causal error decomposition.

claims.value: matched target-marginal mean ED 0.1818 versus historical shared 0.3947; PWH28 favors shared field
claims.scope: held-donor baseline audit
claims.allowed_wording: The target-marginal baseline challenges a universal held-donor method ranking.

claims.value: 27-fit common-reference shared CFM 0.5466 to 0.3983; 3/3 donor blocks improved
claims.scope: donor-count common-reference audit
claims.allowed_wording: Adding a second donor improved the current common-reference pilot, while simple controls also improved.

claims.value: k=2, three-seed mean ED real held source 0.3983, substituted training Wound1 0.2450, training Wound7 marginal 0.1818; only PWH27 favors real over substituted mean
claims.scope: Retrospective source-replacement sensitivity of nine saved fields on the same three healthy acute-wound donors; 50 draws per field are computational, not biological replications
claims.allowed_wording: In the same-cohort three-seed audit, substituting training-donor source cells reduced aggregate error, with donor-specific heterogeneity; consistent incremental value of the new donor's source has not been established.

claims.value: exact equal-donor target marginal mean ED 0.222199 to 0.167598; reduction 0.054601 = quarter component-pair ED 0.054601; maximum identity residual 2.44e-15; 3 held donors
claims.scope: Validated empirical energy-distance arithmetic in fixed coordinates; scientific interpretation remains exploratory and uses the same three donors
claims.allowed_wording: For equally weighted empirical measures under the unsquared-root energy discrepancy, the mean component error minus mixture error equals one quarter of their mutual discrepancy. The arithmetic identity is verified; it does not establish target-specific information from an additional donor and does not decompose gains from jointly fitted flow fields. No new biological donors, p values or confidence intervals are supplied.

claims.value: 200-particle audit of 9 saved fits, 50 draws per fit; mean ED real 0.4036, mean individual substituted 0.3075, mixed substituted 0.2527; PWH28 real 0.2043, individual A/B 0.2503/0.2636, mixed 0.1904; real lower than both individual alternatives for PWH27/PWH28; mixed lower than real for PWH26/PWH28
claims.scope: Same three healthy acute-wound donors and nine saved fields; matched 200-particle predictions and fixed held targets; no new model training or biological replication
claims.allowed_wording: Individual source replacement and mixing are distinct comparisons: PWH28 favors its real source over either individual alternative but favors the mixture over its real source. The n-cell individual-error mean minus n-total-cell mixture error is not the exact convexity identity; only the actual mixture-component subsets satisfy that identity. These computational draws do not establish universal absence of source-state value or DFU trajectories; no p values or confidence intervals are supplied.

claims.value: 12 paired exact-time fits; 3 donors; seeds 0/1/2; 8000 steps; rank/days/sqrt_days/log_days flow ED 0.810395/2.154235/0.874603/0.772475; centroid ED 0.666674/0.977479/0.747631/0.665405; unchanged ED 1.474552
claims.scope: Complete paired random-stream exact-time grid; centroid uses the same donor future day30, a retrospective interpolation task.
claims.allowed_wording: The historical nearest-grid scan is separate. Seed ranges are not biological confidence intervals; no target-guided best clock is selected. This is not clinical validation and does not close the paired-method comparison.

claims.value: 27 saved fits; 3 healthy donors; 12259 observed cells; 5383/7002 genes; no new training; observed-expression TV k1/k2: flow 0.293369/0.282262; mean displacement 0.288159/0.282494; decoded target marginal 0.258958/0.254613; observed target marginal 0.127875/0.111475; decoded persistence 0.352886/0.352886; observed persistence 0.342123/0.342123
claims.scope: Equal-cell common-panel mean expression against actual held-donor count-derived proportions, not decoded truth.
claims.allowed_wording: These are not absolute counts and not biological confidence intervals. Decoder reconstruction is not a mathematical lower error bound. POP05 remains partially addressed; this is not clinical or external validation.
